##### Project general facts

Juman 2 is an exclusive waterfront residential, offering a refined collection of contemporary residences designed around the beauty of coastal living. Set along the marina, the project combines modern architecture with regional influences, spacious layouts, and front-row views of the waterfront, marina, and Abu Dhabi skyline. The residences include executive suites, stylish lofts, and spacious four-bedroom apartments, each thoughtfully designed to balance functionality, comfort, and contemporary elegance.

Residents of Juman 2 enjoy a resort-inspired lifestyle supported by a comprehensive range of amenities. The development features an infinity swimming pool, gym, active studio, sauna, cinema and game room, playground, splash pad, barbecue area, community hall, and 24/7 concierge and security services. Residents also benefit from retail and F&B options, as well as access to the wider Marina District, including a 600-metre waterfront promenade, jogging and cycling tracks, and a multipurpose court.

Juman 2 blends modern luxury with functional and environmentally conscious design, integrating green spaces and waterfront elements throughout the development. Each residence is created to frame panoramic surroundings and provide a seamless connection to the marina lifestyle, while high-quality, efficient design enhances everyday comfort. The project’s architecture and public spaces are conceived to combine aesthetic appeal, sustainability, and a relaxed resort atmosphere.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Raha Beach is one of Abu Dhabi’s most prestigious waterfront destinations, located along the coastline within Abu Dhabi. The area is known for its modern urban planning, combining residential, commercial, and leisure spaces in a vibrant seaside setting. With its prime location near the main highway and key city landmarks, it offers both convenience and a relaxed coastal lifestyle.

The community features a wide range of lifestyle amenities, including marinas, private beaches, landscaped promenades, retail outlets, cafes, and dining destinations. Residents benefit from a well-developed infrastructure with schools, healthcare facilities, and recreational spaces, making it ideal for families and professionals alike. Its waterfront environment encourages outdoor living, with walking paths, cycling tracks, and open spaces overlooking the Arabian Gulf.

Al Raha Beach enjoys excellent connectivity, situated just minutes away from Zayed International Airport, Yas Island, and the city center. The area offers a balanced lifestyle that combines urban convenience with seaside tranquility, making it a highly desirable location for both residential living and real estate investment in Abu Dhabi.
